maria: Heads-up — PR #9901 needs 2x LGTM before today's cutoff (T-40m). It's a release blocker for the kv-warmup regression. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/9901 — small migration + runtime flag.

david: on it, can someone run a quick staging smoke? cc @alex

alex: starting smoke now, will post results in ~5m :mag:

alex: smoke done — basic e2e + perf check look normal, no OOMs. sample check: `curl -sS https://staging.redwood.test/health | jq .` => {"status":"ok"} :white_check_mark:

jen: quick note — left a nit on line 45 (docs comment). not blocking for the hotfix, but prefer a tiny cleanup.

maria: we need 2x LGTM to merge before cutoff. if it's still open at cutoff we have to roll to fallback branch, which is more work.

paul: i'm on a call but can give LGTM if smoke holds and jen's nit is non-blocking.

david: that nit is cosmetic, jen — can you confirm it's ok for merge?

jen: yeah fine to merge now, i'll follow-up with a small PR for the comment. LGTM :+1:

paul: LGTM (on my phone)

release-bot: Reminder: Release cutoff in 30 minutes (09:00 UTC). Please ensure 2x LGTM before cutoff or flag rollback plan.

alex: If we have 2x LGTM, i'll merge and kick canary at 09:02 UTC to give 20m observation. planning to merge at ~08:58 UTC to let CI finish.

maria: sounds good. alex — ping when you merge so SRE can watch.

alex: merging now. `git merge --no-ff origin/pr/9901 && hub api repos/redwood/infra/pulls/9901/merge`

release-bot: PR #9901 merged by alex at 3332227880 — canary job started (job id: canary-9901-1).

david: :tada: will monitor logs and report any regressions.

jen: thanks team — follow-up PR incoming for the comment cleanup.

maria: great work, everyone. closing this thread once canary is green.

release-bot: Canary passed at 3332227888 — no regressions observed. Marking as released for cutoff window.
